about: Labeled PRs for the contribution-triage eval. linked_issue, branch_name, and title come from the PR data and were checked with a separate script. verification, ui_evidence, one_problem, and docs are draft hand labels for a maintainer to confirm; "borderline": true marks the ones a reasonable maintainer could call either way. These PRs predate the evidence rules, so the labels say how the rules apply, not whether the authors followed them.
